metadata.title: Cloud Access Security Broker

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for discovering, governing, and securing access to cloud services, including sanctioned and unsanctioned SaaS usage.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Cloud access security brokers, SaaS usage visibility systems, inline and API-based policy enforcement mechanisms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for governing cloud application access, shadow IT visibility, and policy enforcement through CASB capabilities.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: CASB capabilities depend on cloud-native identity and authentication mechanisms.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: CASB capabilities rely on cloud activity visibility and telemetry.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Credential access via unmanaged or poorly governed cloud applications.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Collection of sensitive data through unsanctioned or misused SaaS platforms.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Defense evasion by shifting activity to cloud services outside formal governance.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of valid accounts in cloud services to maintain access and evade detection.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Automated data exfiltration via legitimate cloud service APIs.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Data access control and policy enforcement for cloud applications.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Monitoring and alerting on risky or policy-violating cloud usage.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Application discovery and classification to surface shadow IT.

metadata.remarks: Cloud Access Security Broker defines the trust properties required to discover, govern, and enforce security policy over access to cloud applications. This pattern addresses shadow IT, unsanctioned SaaS usage, and data exposure risks that arise outside traditional infrastructure-centric security controls.

components.title: Cloud Application Discovery
components.description: Identifies and classifies cloud applications in use across the organization.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cloud application usage is identified to surface sanctioned and unsanctioned services.

components.title: Cloud Access Policy Enforcement
components.description: Applies security and data protection policies to cloud application access.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Access to cloud applications is governed according to defined security policies.

components.title: Cloud Application Data Protection
components.description: Protects sensitive data accessed or stored within cloud applications.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Sensitive data in cloud applications is monitored and protected against inappropriate exposure.
